plan: duel (game/probe/unit_probe.py DUEL_*; the orchestrator's order of 16.11 night)
why: The turn probe (e0afc53, turn_game.json): the twin's anvil (spearmen_0, then swordsmen) against stormvermin_1 lost 0.61-0.75 of its health where the game's lost 0.36-0.38 (solo: the anvil routs at 171 s with E down 0.056 in the game, 197 s and 0.121 in the twin), while clanrats_1 fit (0.325 against 0.331). Every earlier probe used one or two unit types and mostly fearless enemies: which unit cards are off, pair by pair, before the simulator's next window.
what: The stage-0 melee infantry pool, net/config/stage0.json roster (the tactic scenes' and the general battles' draw; the passports sim/config/units.json): Empire swordsmen, spearmen_0, spearmen_1, halberdiers, greatswords; Skaven clanrats_0, clanrats_1, clanrat_spearmen_0, clanrat_spearmen_1, skavenslaves_0, skavenslave_spearmen_0, stormvermin_0, stormvermin_1 (tags swords spear0 spear1 halb gs / clan0 clan1 cspear0 cspear1 slave sspear sv0 sv1). All 40 cross-faction pairs in both roles (kind 'X>Y': X attacks at a run a standing Y never ordered, 60 m front to front); every unit keeps its morale (no fearless flags but the parked lords); the passport men (Empire 120, Skaven 160 / 180), 30 m fronts (every probe's), flat ground of the probes' map. A lane ends 480 s after its contact or 'quiet' (a side out - routing, shattered or dead - and no melee flag for 30 s). 24 battles of 10 lanes (5 Empire attackers, 5 Skaven; all 5 Empire units against 5 different Skaven ones), 20 units + the 2 parked lords = 22, 2,842 men a battle (the 100 ms step); battles 1-8 every (pair, role) once, 9-16 and 17-24 again on other places: 3 lanes a (pair, role), 240 lanes. Two rows of 5 places (z -420 / +330, x inside the game's |x| <= ~763 clamp, the rows offset 160 m in x), the attacker on the +z side; the lords parked at x -+790 (clamped), z -40. No memory rows. Attack on attack is not in: the count does not allow it inside ~24 battles (it would be 8 more a cell).
measures: By lane from the unit rows every 0.25 s (unit_probe.duel_measure): c0 the lane's first melee flag; each unit's share of its starting health lost from the sample before c0 to c0 + 60 / 120 / 240 s and to the end (a window past the end reads the end; the twin, which runs on, ends by the entry's rule on its rows); first rout, rallied (a rout's end not shattered), routs, s from c0; the winner (the side not out at the end; 'none' neither out at 480 s); the CLEAN RATE of each - its health lost a second as a share of its start, over the sample intervals from c0 where both carry the melee flag, up to the first moment either routs or falls below half its starting men (the fight before morale ends it). Tables by kind: mean +- se over the lanes (the twin: 8 copies, 1 m jitter - deterministic in practice, its se is not an error).

decision.D1_fit: For each (pair, role): the twin's clean loss rate of each unit against the game's lanes - 'fits' when inside two errors of the game's mean (se over its >= 3 lanes) or inside +-20 % of it, else 'off+' (the twin's unit loses faster than the game's) or 'off-'. The twin read: HEAD on the same layouts (the plan's own places here; after the run, the twin on the recorded starts).
decision.D2_cards: A unit's card is OFF when it is off the same way in both roles of at least two pairs: 'takes' = its own loss rate (off+ takes too much: its defence too weak in the twin, or every enemy's attack too strong on it), 'deals' = its enemy's loss rate across from it (off+ deals too much). The report ranks the cards by the mean ln(twin / game) over the unit's kinds.
decision.D3_by_target: The design's S5 block says the excess of hits a swing is by TARGET (stormvermin, halberdiers, spearmen; nil for swordsmen and clanrats). Table: ln(twin / game) of the struck unit's clean rate, the cell (striker, target) the mean over the roles; the share of the cells' variance the target's means take against the striker's. 'By target' when the target's share is the larger and the off cells group by the target's card (charge-defence carriers spear0 spear1 halb cspear0 cspear1 sv0; armour >= 90 gs sv0 sv1; missile shields swords spear1 clan1 cspear1 sv1); else 'by striker'. Stated only: no fitting, no new simulator number - the fix is the designer's.
decision.stated: Beside, not deciding: the winner, the rout times and the end shares game | twin; the parked passports' twin (tmp/passports/units.json) beside HEAD.

verdict.D1_fit: 160 unit-rates (80 kinds x 2): 93 fit, 44 off+ (the twin's unit loses faster), 23 off-. By the pair's base hit chance p = 35 + attack - defence (passports): p < 0.25 - 32 off+, 24 fit, 0 off-; 0.25-0.40 - 50 fit, 12 off+, 8 off-; p >= 0.40 - 15 off-, 19 fit, 0 off+. The winner (majority of 3) is the same in 60 of 80 kinds; 15 of the 20 others are the game's 'none' - a routed attacker rallied and came back to fight to 480 s (the game rallies 42 of 68 attacker routs, the twin 53 of 126); real flips: sv1>gs (the game: gs routs at 343 s; the twin: sv1 routs at 387 s), clan0>halb (game halb holds, clanrats break at 413 s; twin halb routs at 419 s), cspear0>halb, cspear0>swords.
verdict.D2_cards: By the line (off the same way in both roles of >= 2 pairs): OFF - halberdiers takes too much (off+ with clan0, clan1, sspear; mean ln +0.39), stormvermin_1 takes too much (spear1, swords; +0.25), stormvermin_0 takes too much (spear0, spear1; +0.16), greatswords deals too little (clan0, slave, sspear; -0.22), skavenslave_spearmen takes too little (gs, halb; -0.21), spearmen_1 deals too much (sv0, sv1; +0.16). Near, not by the line (one pair or mixed): skavenslave_spearmen deals +0.45, skavenslaves deals +0.39 / takes -0.26, clanrat_spearmen_1 / _0 deal +0.27 / +0.24, spearmen_0 takes +0.20, stormvermin_1 deals -0.15. The ranking is in the report (and verdicts.cards).
verdict.D3_by_target: By the line: NOT by target - the striker's means take 0.62 of the 80 cells' variance, the target's 0.50; the off cells do not group by the target's card (with / without: charge-defence carriers +0.13 / -0.01, armour >= 90 +0.16 / +0.03, shields +0.11 / +0.02 - all three groups hold the elite units, which are struck at low chance). Beyond the line, read off the same table: neither card - the PAIR's hit chance takes 0.73 of the variance (r = -0.86; ln(twin/game) +0.51 at p < 0.10, +0.31 at 0.10-0.20, +0.15 at 0.20-0.30, -0.04 at 0.30-0.45, -0.22 at >= 0.45), the ln of HEAD's swing law iv / (p iv + miss_s 0.5) 0.73 too (slope 0.62): the twin's damage is too flat in the chance - weak strikers on strong targets deal too much, strong on weak too little. This is the critic's 2 (b) (game swings hit-independent; HEAD's per-man law x2.01 at chance 0.09) seen at the level of whole duels. After the chance, the residual sd 0.125 (raw 0.242): target spearmen_1 -0.23 +- 0.02 (the twin's takes too little), strikers swordsmen / spearmen_1 +0.12 / +0.11, stormvermin_0 / _1 -0.14 / -0.11 (deal too little) - small and for the designer. The turn probe's stormvermin_1 excess fits this: sv1 on spear0 / swords is p 0.39 / 0.41 (the twin's anvil routs 195 / 193 s against the game's 141 / 149 s), spear0 / swords on sv1 p 0.19 / 0.31 (the twin's sv1 takes x1.2-1.3). No fitting, no new number: the fix is the designer's.
